lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into at least five distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with roughly equidistant vertical spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the columns of circular blobs, creating a grid-like visual structure where blobs serve as nodes at the intersection of vertical and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and low-intensity pixels in the shadowed ventral trough.
